description:
MCP schema generation completes cleanly, with the `$ref` resolver's warning cause fixed at the generator boundary rather than the warning calls suppressed.

## Background

The `$ref` resolver in `mcp-server/lib/tool-generator.js` emits `console.error` warnings for circular references, missing definitions, and unrecognized `$ref` formats. The MCP schema tests pass but emit numerous unresolved-definition and circular-reference warnings, whose volume can hide new regressions. The fix addresses the cause at the generator boundary so generation resolves cleanly, rather than silencing the warning calls.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: MCP schema generation through `mcp-server/lib/tool-generator.js` completes without emitting circular-reference, missing-definition, or unrecognized-`$ref` warnings.
- [hard] REQ-02: The cause is fixed at the generator boundary rather than by suppressing the warning calls.
- [hard] REQ-03: `npm test` in `mcp-server/` passes.

## Notes

Fix the resolution boundary so the warnings do not arise, rather than removing the diagnostic calls.
title: Clean up MCP schema-generator warnings
